title: The BOINC server's committed settings, contrib-compute/infra/boinc/env/<env>.json
description: Public settings that scripts/provision-boinc.sh deploys as the stack usnm-boinc-<env> into usnm-boinc-rg-<env>, and scripts/build-boinc-images.sh updates with the images it builds. Nothing secret belongs here: the secrets are made in Azure (contrib-compute/infra/boinc/modules/keyvault.bicep). Keys sorted. provision-boinc.sh checks the same rules with jq.

assessment.description: Run the server from the bridge image (the server image plus usnm-boinc), so the usnm_assess and usnm_gold validators can run: main.bicep's assessment parameter.

codeSignPublicKey.description: The PUBLIC half of the offline code-signing key (code_sign_public), as text. Empty until it is made on the offline machine. The private half never comes here or to Azure.

images.description: Images by registry digest, or empty before the first build. server and bridge are in the app's shared registry (infra/names/<env>.json) and come from scripts/build-boinc-images.sh; with server empty, the stack deploys only the base resources. worker is the public GHCR package that volunteers pull (ADR-0019, addendum), from .github/workflows/boinc-worker.yml.

location.description: Azure region; the resource group's own.

operator.description: The Entra user or group that gets Key Vault Secrets Officer and is named as the MySQL Entra administrator in the printed step.

projectUrl.description: The BOINC master URL. Permanent once volunteers attach.
